interactive.description: Whether someone will answer the agent. true: it may ask a question, which parks the task in AWAITING_INPUT until your next prompt on the conversation (delivered as the answer) or a respond. false: nobody will answer, so it decides or gives up with a reason. resolvedAt.description: When that deployment was created. Surface this when it is older than the latest deployment, so a stale config is not presented as current.

ResolvedFileConfigSummary.description: The repo config file as of the most recent deployment that read it.

sameNetwork.description: Whether this request comes from the same IP as the terminal. False when the terminal's IP is unknown.

SSHSignupOriginSummary.description: Where the terminal that started an SSH signup connected from.

SSHSignupTrialSummary.description: The anonymous trial box the offered SSH key currently owns; approving the signup claims it.

domains.description: Railway-provided public HTTP domains whose routes have been published.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before the sandbox is destroyed. 0 means it never idles out; null means unknown, including for a destroyed sandbox.

privateDomain.description: Hostname on the environment's private network, e.g. <name>.railway.internal, reachable on any port from services in that environment. Null when the VM is isolated or its private endpoint isn't registered yet.

key.description: The checkpoint's identity within the environment (same as id): a recipe content hash for a built template, or the user-given name for one captured from a sandbox.

SandboxCheckpoint.description: A bootable snapshot of a sandbox's disk, scoped to an environment. Built from a template recipe or captured from a running sandbox.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before the sandbox is destroyed. Any value <= 0 means never idle out (plan-gated). Defaults to the plan's default idle timeout.

networkIsolation.description: Network access for the sandbox. Defaults to ISOLATED (no private network access). Public domains require PRIVATE to be selected explicitly.

publicDomains.description: Railway-provided HTTP domains to publish, one per unique prefix and port. Supports up to 10 and requires explicitly selecting PRIVATE networking. Domain prefixes are generated when omitted.

region.description: Region to place the sandbox in (e.g. us-west2, us-east4-eqdc4a). Defaults to the platform default region when omitted.

resources.description: Creation-time CPU and memory, including for forks and checkpoint restores. Each omitted or null field uses the workspace's sandbox default; explicit values must not exceed its independent VM maximum.

sourceSandboxId.description: Fork an existing running sandbox in this environment. Mutually exclusive with template.

variables.description: Environment variables baked into the sandbox, available to every command. Values may contain Railway variable references (e.g. ${{shared.FOO}}, ${{ServiceName.BAR}}), resolved at create time.

port.description: Target port on the sandbox, from 1 through 65535.

prefix.description: Optional DNS label prefix for the generated domain. When omitted, a prefix is generated from the project name. Custom prefixes must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional interior hyphens, up to 46 characters.

port.description: Target port on the sandbox this domain routes to.

prefix.description: Label prefix requested when the sandbox was created.

SandboxDomainSummary.description: One public domain on a sandbox.

SandboxNetworkIsolation.description: Controls a sandbox's access to the environment's private network.

cpu.description: Positive vCPU for the new sandbox; fractional values are supported. Omitted or null uses the workspace's sandbox default. Must not exceed its VM maximum.

memoryGB.description: Memory in decimal GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes), rounded to whole bytes. Must be at least 1 byte and at most the workspace's VM maximum. Omitted or null uses its sandbox default.

attached.description: Whether a client is currently connected.

command.description: The command being run; empty for an interactive shell.

foregroundActive.description: For an interactive shell, whether a foreground program currently holds the terminal. Null otherwise, or when the runtime can't report it.

name.description: Stable session name; reconnect/attach by this.

SandboxSession.description: A resumable session inside a sandbox: an interactive shell or a one-off exec command.

SandboxSessionKind.description: Whether a session is an interactive shell or a one-off exec command.

exitCode.description: Process exit code; only meaningful once running is false.

exitedAt.description: When the process exited; null while running.

running.description: Whether the process is still alive.

SandboxTemplateBuild.description: The state of a template build, derived from its workflow and the existence of its checkpoint. READY means the checkpoint exists and can be booted.

instructions.description: Build a template by running these shell instructions on the base image. Mutually exclusive with name.

name.description: Boot from a saved checkpoint with this name (one captured from a sandbox). Mutually exclusive with instructions.

region.description: Placement region for the build sandbox. The resulting checkpoint lives in this region, and sandboxes created from the template boot there. Defaults to the platform default; only the cold build consults it (a built template's own region wins).

variables.description: Environment variables available to the template's build instructions. Values may contain Railway variable references (e.g. ${{shared.FOO}}, ${{ServiceName.BAR}}), resolved at build time.

hasHiddenRegistryCredentialsFromTemplate.description: Whether this service has hidden registry credentials from a template. When true, the credentials are stored in the template and used during deployment.

isRestricted.description: Whether this service has an active restriction that limits its capabilities.

pendingTakedownAcknowledgment.description: The takedown notice blocking deployment, readable by workspace members and staff. Public-project visibility does not grant notice access.

takedownAcknowledgments.description: Every takedown requirement this service has had, newest first, outstanding or cleared. Retained after the service deploys again so the history survives the redeploy it permitted.

schedules.description: List of enabled backup schedule kinds (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY)

branch.description: The branch to connect to. e.g. 'main'

image.description: Name of the Dockerhub or GHCR image to connect this service to.

repo.description: The full name of the repo to connect to. e.g. 'railwayapp/starters'

environmentId.description: Environment ID. If the specified environment is a fork, the service will only be created in it. Otherwise it will created in all environments that are not forks of other environments

kind.description: Creates a Website when WEBSITE. Null for an ordinary service.

templateId.description: Template ID. Required when templateServiceId is provided.

templateServiceId.description: Template service ID within the template's serializedConfig. Required when templateId is provided.

activeDeployments.description: All currently active (deployed and running) deployments for this service instance

autoInstrumentationEnabled.description: Instrument the service's processes with eBPF (OBI) for supported runtimes, no code changes. Only active while tracingEnabled is true.

clearance.description: This service's own Railway Authentication setting. Null means no setting of its own: it follows the environment's default (see clearanceEffective).

clearanceEffective.description: Whether Railway Authentication protects this service's HTTP domains: its own setting, else its environment's default.

hasEverDeployed.description: Whether any deployment was ever created for this service instance, including deployments that have since been removed. Distinguishes a service that was torn down (all deployments removed) from one that has never deployed — latestDeployment and activeDeployments are null/empty for both.

latestDeployment.description: The most recent deployment for this service instance

resolvedFileConfig.description: Config read from the repo's config file, taken from the most recent deployment that actually read it. Null when no deployment has resolved a config file yet. An empty `fileManifest` is a real answer and means the repo has no config file — do not read this off the latest deployment instead, since a deployment whose snapshot never completed carries no file config at all and is not the same as a repo without one.

tracingEnabled.description: Trace requests to the service in this environment: the edge records a span per client-facing request to its domains and the next deploy provides the OpenTelemetry exporter variables.

enabled.description: On or off. Null (or omitted) removes the service's own setting so it follows the environment's default.

memoryGB.description: Amount of memory in GB to allocate to the service instance

vCPUs.description: Number of vCPUs to allocate to the service instance

autoInstrumentationEnabled.description: Instrument the service's processes with eBPF (OBI) while its tracing is on. Reaches running containers within about a minute, no redeploy needed.

tracingEnabled.description: Trace requests to the service in this environment. Takes effect at the edge within seconds and in the app on the next deploy.

ServiceKind.description: What a service is, when it isn't an ordinary service. A Website's builds upload a release that the edge serves.

kind.description: WEBSITE for a Website. Null for an ordinary service.

hasHiddenRegistryCredentialsFromTemplate.description: Whether this service has hidden registry credentials from a template. When true, the credentials are stored in the template and used during deployment.

isRestricted.description: Whether this service has an active restriction that limits its capabilities.

acknowledgedBy.description: The person who attested. Retained after the service deploys again, so the record outlives the gate it cleared.

acknowledgedStatement.description: The attestation exactly as it was worded when it was confirmed.

hasExternalNotice.description: False when no customer-visible notice beyond the dashboard page was recorded, so the UI can say so rather than implying the original complaint is linked.

headline.description: Customer-safe statement of what happened and why.

instruction.description: What the customer has to do before deploying again.

isApplying.description: The service teardown has not yet completed; acknowledgment remains unavailable.

noticeUrl.description: Where to read the notice. Always resolvable: it falls back to the dashboard restriction detail page.

statement.description: The attestation the customer must explicitly confirm. Opening or reading the notice is not acknowledgment.

ServiceTakedownAcknowledgment.description: A takedown notice the customer must acknowledge before the service can deploy again.

instruction.description: What the customer has to do before deploying again.

isApplying.description: The service teardown has not yet completed; acknowledgment remains unavailable.

ServiceTakedownAcknowledgmentSummary.description: A takedown notice the customer must acknowledge before the service can deploy again.

lastEdgeSpanAt.description: When the edge last exported a span for a request to the service; null when it never has within retention

lastServiceSpanAt.description: When the service's own app last exported a span; null when it never has within retention

ServiceTracingStatus.description: Whether a service's requests are producing spans, per exporting hop. The edge tracing a request says nothing about the app behind it.

statement.description: The exact statement shown to and confirmed by the admin.

TakedownNoticeKind.description: Which complaint a takedown answered. OTHER keeps generic wording rather than asserting a legal basis Railway did not record.

publishingAllowance.description: This template's workspace's publishing limits and usage. Null for anyone but the template's owner, and for a template with no workspace.

publishingRestrictionId.description: The active restriction stopping this workspace publishing templates, so a restricted author can be sent to the page that explains it and takes the appeal. Null when publishing is not restricted, and for anyone but the template's owner: the `template` query is public, and whether a workspace is under an abuse restriction is not.

existingRootServiceId.description: An existing database service to convert. If you pass a cluster's proxy service, Railway uses the database behind it.

stageOnly.description: If true, create resources and patch but don't deploy. Returns patchId for later commit.

blockedReason.description: Why the live limit stops this template being published, or null when it doesn't. Always null for a template that is already live: limits gate going live, not edits.

deployingWorkspaces.description: Distinct other workspaces that have deployed any of this workspace's templates.

deployingWorkspacesPerExtraLive.description: Deploying workspaces it takes to raise the live limit by one.

TemplatePublishingAllowanceSummary.description: How many templates this template's workspace may have live, and how many it has. New publishes are also rate limited per day; that limit is not reported here and surfaces as an error when hit. See https://docs.railway.com/templates/publish-and-share#publishing-limits

environmentId.description: The environment ID containing the cluster

groupId.description: The group ID to delete when reverting

projectId.description: The project ID containing the cluster

rootServiceId.description: The root service ID of the HA cluster to revert

stageOnly.description: If true, stage changes instead of deploying. Returns patchId.

serviceIds.description: Provide multiple serviceIds when ejecting services from a monorepo.

component.description: Which hop exported the span: edge, proxy or service

kind.description: INTERNAL, SERVER, CLIENT, PRODUCER, CONSUMER or UNSPECIFIED

resourceAttributes.description: Resource attributes as exported, without the railway.* keys Railway promotes into typed fields, and with cloud.region as the airport code of the region (edge/<pop> on an edge span)

serviceId.description: Railway service the span belongs to, when known

TraceSpanEventSummary.description: A timestamped event on a span

TraceSpanLinkSummary.description: A link from a span to a span in another trace

durationMs.description: From the earliest span start to the latest span end

hasEdge.description: Whether the edge exported any span of the trace

rootComponent.description: Which hop exported the root span: edge (hikari), proxy (tcp-proxy) or service

rootServerAddress.description: The root span's server.address, when it set one

rootServiceId.description: Railway service the root span belongs to

rootSpanName.description: Name of the root span, or of the earliest span when the root is missing

rootUrlPath.description: The root span's url.path, when it set one

serviceName.description: service.name of the earliest span a service exported; null when the request never reached one

startedAt.description: Start of the earliest span (ISO timestamp)

traceId.description: W3C trace id, 32 lower-case hex characters

TraceSummary.description: One trace of an environment: the request as a whole, summarised from its spans

replace.description: When set to true, removes all existing variables before upserting the new collection.

environmentId.description: The environment to deploy the volume instances into. If `null`, the volume will not be deployed to any environment. `undefined` will deploy to all environments.

mountPath.description: The path in the container to mount the volume to

projectId.description: The project to create the volume in

region.description: The region to create the volume instances in. If not provided, the default region will be used.

serviceId.description: The service to attach the volume to. If not provided, the volume will be disconnected.

mountPath.description: The mount path of the volume instance. If not provided, the mount path will not be updated.

serviceId.description: The service to attach the volume to. If not provided, the volume will be disconnected.

state.description: The state of the volume instance. If not provided, the state will not be updated.

archiveContinuityUnverifiedReason.description: Why MySQL archive continuity could not be verified. The restore remains allowed and its image performs the authoritative replay check.

archiveContinuityVerified.description: For MySQL PITR restores, whether archive continuity was verified before the workflow started.

hasAutomaticDiagnosis.description: Whether automatic deployment diagnosis is enabled for this workspace.

hasGuardrailsAccess.description: Whether this workspace has access to guardrails policies.

hasHipaaBAA.description: Whether this workspace has a signed HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, from either the legacy hasBAA flag or the HIPAA_BAA spend commitment feature.

projectCount.description: Total number of projects in this workspace. Used by the dashboard to show an exact count without paginating through every project.

redactedDueTo2FAPending.description: Whether the current user's access is redacted due to pending 2FA requirement. Returns true if the user is a workspace member, workspace has 2FA enforcement enabled, and the current user needs to enable 2FA.

usersWithout2FA.description: Get a list of user emails in the workspace who do not have verified 2FA enabled. Returns an empty array if all users have 2FA enabled.
